scope: Unexposed database foundation only. Not an available or accepted self-service deletion feature.
user_decision: Anonymize the deleted identity; preserve shared history for surviving participants.
implemented: Additive migration 096 adds deleted_at and a durable personal-asset cleanup queue. No existing account is deleted by migration.

A distinct repository verifies owner, active session and expected password hash inside one transaction. Platform administration, owned servers and owned applications block the operation until handoff/removal; existing administrative HardDeleteUser is not reused.

Retain the user row as a non-authenticating tombstone to avoid DM/channel foreign-key cascades. Random replacement username, generic display name, stripped profile/email, invalid password hash, offline/lifecycle state and token version bump. Immutable deleted-user update trigger rejects late profile/credential writes.

Explicit private-state deletion does not depend on foreign-key enforcement: sessions, reset/verification proofs, MFA, device/prekeys, personal backup, recipient envelopes, preferences, personal notes/read states/mutes, memberships/roles and cosmetic/entrance selections.

Shared DM/channel messages and attachments are untouched. Other recipients' sealed sender-key envelopes remain available for their retained history. Other users' preferences/notes and sign-in sessions remain unchanged.
Personal profile/entrance asset URLs are captured in the durable queue before identity removal. Audit identity snapshots and associated metadata are stripped. No filesystem removal happens yet.
